title: Icefield Briefing
summary: The quartermaster sends the expedition north, onto the Stoneguard's shelf.
speaker: char-quartermaster
lines: Nothing's crossed that ice and come back with a story in years.
You held the meadow. That doesn't mean the Stoneguard will care.
Go slow, go loud enough to be seen, and don't chase anything onto ground you haven't checked.

title: After the Twin-Strike
summary: The expedition member reflects on the meadow's first real wall, now down.
speaker: char-expedition-member
lines: It hit twice before I finished reacting to the first one.
The meadow's not testing us anymore. It's done testing us.
Whatever's past the tree line, it won't be this polite about it.

title: The Countess's Briefing
summary: The War-Countess sends the militia out to double the watch on Embervale's west wall.
speaker: char-war-countess
lines: The west wall held last night. That doesn't mean it holds tonight.
Double the watch. Thin whatever's testing the dark past the tree line — don't chase it further than that.
I've buried enough of this town's sons learning that lesson twice. Learn it once, if you can.

title: The Speaker's Briefing
summary: The Speaker of Norhollow sends the militia to walk the palisade and reset the line.
speaker: char-speaker-of-norhollow
lines: Nine notches on the west stakes. Three came loose since the frost. That's the count.
Walk the line, reset what's loose, and thin anything using the dark to test it.
Ask me what I think when the tallies stop needing fixed. Not before.
